blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The canonical 2026-09-01 capture at 2026-09-01T01:02:39+05:00 fails every required goal surface, so the verified streak remains 0/7: Apple weather search is >192, the official Apple Weather chart is #66, all three fixed logged-out Google category profiles are outside the first 30, and 0/5 generic Google queries qualify. The auxiliary Apple Toshkent ob-havo search returned only one unique result and remains a non-goal diagnostic error; required goal evidence is complete. The current App Store Connect overview reports 300 impressions, 23 product-page views, 8 first downloads, 1 redownload, 3 updates, and 4.86% conversion; retention is insufficient. The conversion is preserved as reported because the supplied counts and report window do not reproduce it. A separate public Apple UZ lookup reports 1 rating at 5.0 while public version 1.0.1 remains live. Public iOS 1.0.1 (4) has two reported crashes, one on August 25 and one on August 29. The August 29 event maps to iPhone; the August 25 device/OS dimension is suppressed or unavailable, and neither exposes a diagnostic, stack, incident/signature ID, or crashed-binary UUID. The crash gate therefore remains blocked. Google Play's global last-28-days dashboard counts were revalidated on August 31 at 25 installs, 18 device first launches, and 13 monthly active devices; listing impressions, conversion, and ratings remain carried forward where marked.

Current product/build-input commit 8fc43b48b65d17b3339663549cd86208f62f6bb7 is governed by the canonical fail-closed release registry. Product/build-input commit 8fc43b48b65d17b3339663549cd86208f62f6bb7 resolves to Android phone 1.1.0 (10), Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000010), and Apple 1.1.0 (8). It fixes the duplicate-percent share payload found during exact build-7 TestFlight physical QA and adds a regression test; targeted Android-host StoreLinkProviderTest passed. No exact-source hosted CI, protected signing receipt, signed artifact hash, independent byte verification, internal-store delivery, or physical runtime evidence exists yet for this revision. The manifest is fail-closed at 0/3 verified-current; vc9, vc1000009, and build 7 remain historical evidence and cannot be relabeled current. All predecessor artifacts and observations are historical and non-transferable. OpenMeteo GmbH confirmed non-commercial API entitlement in ticket 234272 for the exact free, non-monetized, unpaid-organic-promotion scope. Predecessor phone and Wear AABs embed 9c2dce4, pass Bundletool and ZIP integrity, and have zero signature entries. Their SHA-256 values are b7c7acb6e90189e8d73e5b8a5f780bf1d3ab36f43edaf3d5076a1dba4e22d4e5 and 2d73fdf1e4fd661a96a699a9fd2ef7b2e989b0f4ab019692ce7c97465673d3fa. Predecessor Apple app, widget, and watch Release simulator hashes are b7c3ba937658007b07ee9ad8e85ddc892e90f423e7839e0dc112a1070ea04849, 7191acd40334d4d9fec6062bc5023450fefbb55006fbd92f57109f41eb27a7ff, and c310c785750ffa779e5dfdc30384088fca889deddb11417f2b4e8e0e30109728; UUID-matched dSYMs verify, but all are ad-hoc simulator products. The full Gradle release gate, shared iOS simulator suite, 18 Apple surface tests, and localization parity pass. A clean predecessor physical General Mobile API 25 run passed Tashkent without location permission, live forecast, truthful late-day Best Time, durable-tip persistence, offline cache, recovery, process health, and cleanup; built and installed APK bytes matched at 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 and the product-scoped fatal/ANR/SSL/CertPath/trust-anchor filter had zero matches. The exact-source API 24 emulator APK 168bb6acdb95453a8dfd141947edbcb9292b756fd3429fffa56fc4baf125dbec retains its live/cache/recovery pass. The byte-identical predecessor debug APK and API 36 installed bytes 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 also passed a fresh no-snapshot Pixel Tablet emulator smoke in Uzbek: landscape onboarding, live forecast, Best Time, durable-tip persistence, home-screen widget render/tap, large text, rotation, process health, and cleanup passed. This is emulator debug evidence, not physical-tablet or upload-signed release proof. Twelve EN/RU/UZ iPhone phone sources now come from the source-bound predecessor 9c2dce4 build-6 simulator app and cover overview, recent comparison, selected timeline, and 10-day/AQI details in each locale. The attempted Apple offline transition was not captured and no Apple offline-state source is claimed. This proves localized phone screenshot provenance only, not signing, physical-device, TestFlight, or store state. Apple Watch sources remain historical build-5 simulator evidence, and prior API 37 round-Wear evidence remains historical. Canonical release authority remains fail-closed. Product/build-input commit 8fc43b48b65d17b3339663549cd86208f62f6bb7 resolves to Android phone 1.1.0 (10), Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000010), and Apple 1.1.0 (8). It fixes the duplicate-percent share payload found during exact build-7 TestFlight physical QA and adds a regression test; targeted Android-host StoreLinkProviderTest passed. No exact-source hosted CI, protected signing receipt, signed artifact hash, independent byte verification, internal-store delivery, or physical runtime evidence exists yet for this revision. The manifest is fail-closed at 0/3 verified-current; vc9, vc1000009, and build 7 remain historical evidence and cannot be relabeled current. Exact historical phone vc9 and Wear vc1000009 are protected-signed, independently byte-verified, and active on separate Google Play Internal tracks. Google Play delivered vc9 to the dedicated physical API-25 phone with the branded launcher; cold/live Tashkent forecast, Best Time, share resolver, manual refresh, widget render/open, and bounded fatal/ANR/TLS filters passed. No replacement physical tablet, paired Wear vc1000009 install/handoff, or post-delivery vitals exist. Successor source 8fc43b48b65d17b3339663549cd86208f62f6bb7 advances to phone vc10 and Wear vc1000010 for the cross-platform share fix but has no signed artifacts, store delivery, or physical evidence. The Samsung API-36 device contains user data and was not modified. Production was not changed. The gate remains blocked. Exact historical Apple 1.1.0 (7) completed Transporter processing, entered the internal TestFlight group as Testing, and was installed from TestFlight on the connected iPhone 14 Pro. Bundle inventory proved 1.1.0 (7); cold launch, live Tashkent forecast, Best Time, first-success tip, manual refresh, and the native share sheet passed. Copied share content failed because it contained 0%% instead of 0%. No Nimbo widget render/open, iPad TestFlight install, paired-watch install/handoff, iOS 15 runtime, crash diagnosis, or post-delivery crash-free window exists. Successor source 8fc43b48b65d17b3339663549cd86208f62f6bb7 advances to build 8 with the regression-tested fix but has no signed artifact or TestFlight runtime evidence. The gate remains blocked. No production submission or release followed. Apple subtitles and creatives remain repository-prepared payloads, not an App Store Connect draft or public store state. The same authenticated preflight found zero existing analytics report requests. Exactly one bounded ONGOING analytics-report-request POST for app 6799886897 returned security 403 without a resource ID; it was not retried, and no duplicate, report instance, segment, user-level data, or PII was created or downloaded. Automated weekly Apple analytics remains permission-blocked for the current key. The domain and point-in-time store-policy gates remain pass, every critical console guardrail remains unknown, and the latest validated weekly Play slice has zero UZ visitors, so UZ conversion remains unknown; its 42.31% all-country rate is diagnostic only. Scale status remains hold; public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on every blocking canonical quality gate and critical console guardrail.

## Authenticated Play context

At 23:17–23:23 +05:00 on August 31, the global last-28-days dashboard reported 25 installs, 18 device first launches, and 13 monthly active devices. The directional first-launch ratio is 72.00%; it is not promoted to a decision-eligible cohort rate because the UI does not prove identical populations. Play impressions, listing conversion, ratings, and production details remain carried forward where explicitly marked. The separate August 18–24 Store Listings import remains authoritative for its own window: 26 all-country visitors and 11 unique install clicks, while UZ had zero visitors and zero clicks.

A 05:05 +05:00 recheck confirms review request 14 still contains only the Uzbekistan Custom Store Listing's en-US and ru-RU store data and is under review. Managed publishing is off; approval, publication, and rank impact are not verified. A fixed logged-out gl=UZ recheck at the same checkpoint still exposed the pre-review public title Nimbo in both Uzbek and Russian product pages, so propagation is explicitly not verified. Phone Internal track 4700083514281298386 is active with the selected four-account License testers group. On September 1 the General Mobile opt-in was accepted and Google Play delivered version 1.1.0 (8) for bounded API 25 cold/live/share, offline/cache/recovery, large-text, and active system-TalkBack smoke. Wear Internal track 4699242452771231163 now has the same tester list and reports Active, but no physical Wear install exists. Evidence: growth/quality/google-play-console-2026-08-31.md and growth/quality/play-delivered-android-smoke-2026-09-01.md, with public response hashes in growth/quality/google-play-public-propagation-2026-09-01.md and the current cross-store state in growth/quality/store-release-recheck-2026-09-01.md.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

query.sql:
-- Reproducible bounded store-evidence snapshot based on the 2026-08-31 console
-- reads and the 2026-09-01 public Apple UZ rating/version lookup.
-- Apple overview values and selected Google global last-28-days dashboard
-- values are current read-only observations. Stale listing values are marked.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('App Store', 'Impressions', '300', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'First-time downloads', '8', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'Conversion rate', '4.86%', 'live_console_2026-08-31_reported'),
    ('App Store', 'Ratings', '1', 'public_itunes_lookup_uz_2026-09-01'),
    ('App Store', 'Crashes', '2', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Impressions', '779', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('Google Play', 'Installations', '25', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'First launches', '18', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Monthly active devices', '13', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Conversion rate', '40.82%', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('Google Play', 'Ratings', '1', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated')
) AS baseline(platform, metric, value, evidence_class);
query.description: Loads the bounded 2026-08-31 store-console evidence plus the September 1 public Apple UZ rating/version lookup while keeping current global Play dashboard counts distinct from stale listing metrics.
filters: Console snapshot date 2026-08-31; public Apple UZ lookup rechecked 2026-09-01
Apple public UZ rating 5.0 from 1 rating; no review text exposed
Google installs, first launches, and monthly active devices are current global last-28-days counts
Google impressions, listing conversion, and ratings are carried forward from 2026-08-28
No cross-platform or cross-window denominator coercion
metric_definitions: Apple conversion is the App Store Connect reported 4.86% and is not recomputed from supplied counts
Retention is insufficient and remains unknown rather than zero
Play conversion is the 2026-08-28 reported baseline and was not revalidated on 2026-08-31
First launch rate is 18 / 25 = 72.00% and remains directional
Monthly active users is displayed as the Play Console's monthly active devices count

-- Baseline-versus-target percentages used in the growth control room.
-- The Play conversion and launch-rate reads remain directional until their
-- source populations and time windows are reconciled.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('Apple conversion', 'Baseline', 0.0486),
    ('Apple conversion', 'Target', 0.1500),
    ('Play conversion', 'Baseline', 0.4082),
    ('Play conversion', 'Target', 0.3500),
    ('First launch / install', 'Baseline', 0.7200),
    ('First launch / install', 'Target', 0.8000)

filters: Only percentage drivers with an observed baseline
